source.title: Replace model-driven GitHub status polling with receipts
source.objective: Retrospective bottleneck from ChatGPT conversation 6ab8f2d7-ad14-83eb-b53b-c386288d3e46: C2 used external GitHub polling as synchronization, e.g. a loop of repeated gh issue view 2319 checks every ~2 s until OPEN became CLOSED, consuming ~19 s. Replace or minimize polling where canonical writer/runtime receipts/events can provide completion acknowledgement directly.
source.next_action: Reassess after Symphony acquisition/migration scope is decided; resume only if the capability remains necessary outside Symphony.
